title: Shopper Earnings Terms — Guaranteed Offer Figure for Cartwise Shopper Batches with Late Orders
content:
**Condition.** In a shown-pay claim on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the pay before tips standing is compared against the guaranteed offer figure, which is found by the late-order guarantee method from the late-delivery violations the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record carries against that batch:

(a) when **two or more** late-delivery violations are recorded against the batch and it carried **two or more orders**, the shown pay is prorated to the orders delivered on time: the shown pay multiplied by the on-time orders (all orders less the late-delivery violations) divided by all orders, rounded to the cent half up;

(b) when **exactly one** late-delivery violation is recorded against a batch of **two or more orders**, the shown pay is reduced by the batch type's pay per additional order;

(c) otherwise the shown pay stands whole.

The batch type's pay per additional order is 3.00 for the Double Delivery Batch and the Triple Delivery Batch, and 0.00 for the Shop-Only Batch, Express 30 Batch, Single Delivery Batch and Stock-Up Batch.

## Condition matrix

| Late-delivery violations against the batch | Orders in the batch | Guaranteed offer figure |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 or more | Shown pay times on-time orders divided by all orders, rounded half up |
| 1 | 2 or more | Shown pay less the batch type's pay per additional order |
| Any | 1 | Shown pay whole |
| 0 | Any | Shown pay whole |

## Worked figures (hypothetical offers)

- Triple Delivery Batch, shown pay 19.00, two late-delivery violations: one order on time, 19.00 multiplied by 1 divided by 3 is 6.3333, rounded to 6.33.
- Double Delivery Batch, shown pay 16.00, one late-delivery violation: 16.00 less 3.00 gives 13.00.
- Single Delivery Batch, shown pay 12.00, two late-delivery violations: a one-order batch, so 12.00 stands whole.
